about: PROPOSED for the kit (01_Shared_Parameters\FMC_SharedParameters.txt through _build/fmc_data.py PARAMS_V22, and the Parameters_STD002 tab), drafted 19 Oct 2026 for the engineering-services track. The BIM Manager approves it through the kit change process; until then no plugin binds these names as standard. FMC_Auto_MEP_Parameters.txt beside this file is the same list as a Revit shared-parameter file.
name: FMC Auto-MEP and Electrical parameters
guid_method: uuid5(namespace 6f0c2b7e-4a51-4e0b-9d3a-f0c3a1b2c3d4, parameter name): the kit's own method (_build/build_kit.py, NS on line 21; it reproduces FMC_Project_Code = 9a41f255-057a-54f2-959f-d295edf4416b). So the kit build makes the same GUIDs from the names, and a renamed parameter gets a new GUID.

proposed.name: FMC_Room_Type
proposed.description: Room services type id from FMC_Rulebook_RoomServices (e.g. office, ward_bay, icu_bed); picks the room's services rules
proposed.why: Auto-MEP and the recipe tree need a stable, language-free room type; FMC_Occupancy_Type is the building-code class, not the services use

proposed.name: FMC_Auto_Stage
proposed.categories: Rooms, Spaces, Lighting Fixtures, Lighting Devices, Electrical Fixtures, Electrical Equipment, Data Devices, Fire Alarm Devices, Security Devices, Plumbing Fixtures, Plumbing Equipment, Mechanical Equipment, Air Terminals, Sprinklers, Specialty Equipment, Generic Models, Pipes, Pipe Fittings, Ducts, Duct Fittings, Conduits, Cable Trays
proposed.description: On an element: the Auto-MEP stage that placed it. On a room: the last stage a person approved for that room
proposed.why: Lets a run resume and lets a person approve one stage at a time

proposed.name: FMC_Auto_Run
proposed.categories: Rooms, Spaces, Lighting Fixtures, Lighting Devices, Electrical Fixtures, Electrical Equipment, Data Devices, Fire Alarm Devices, Security Devices, Plumbing Fixtures, Plumbing Equipment, Mechanical Equipment, Air Terminals, Sprinklers, Specialty Equipment, Generic Models, Pipes, Pipe Fittings, Ducts, Duct Fittings, Conduits, Cable Trays
proposed.description: Auto-MEP run id (fmc-auto-run journal) that placed or last changed this element; blank = placed by a person
proposed.why: Ties every placed element to its run journal so a run can be undone or audited

proposed.name: FMC_Auto_Locked
proposed.categories: Rooms, Spaces, Lighting Fixtures, Lighting Devices, Electrical Fixtures, Electrical Equipment, Data Devices, Fire Alarm Devices, Security Devices, Plumbing Fixtures, Plumbing Equipment, Mechanical Equipment, Air Terminals, Sprinklers, Specialty Equipment, Generic Models, Pipes, Pipe Fittings, Ducts, Duct Fittings, Conduits, Cable Trays
proposed.description: Yes = a person has taken this element (or room) over; Auto-MEP never moves, re-types or deletes it
proposed.why: A rebuild must never silently undo a person's work (PLAN_RECIPE_TREE rule)

proposed.name: FMC_AI_Hint_Kind
proposed.description: Kind of AI hint marker: DB_Here, Riser_Zone, No_Services, Keep_Clear, Feature_Light, Supply_Intake (FMC_AI_Hint_Marker types)
proposed.why: A person steers Auto-MEP by dropping a marker in the model instead of typing instructions

proposed.name: FMC_Switch_Ref
proposed.categories: Lighting Fixtures, Lighting Devices, Electrical Fixtures, Generic Models
proposed.description: Switch or switch group that controls this fitting, e.g. L4 (Revit's Switch ID is read-only without circuits)
proposed.why: KISIC gap script 19 binds an ad-hoc parameter 'FMC Switch'; switching cannot be recorded without it
proposed.replaces: FMC Switch (KISIC 19_fmc_switch_param.cs): copy its values across, then remove it from the model

proposed.name: FMC_Elec_System
proposed.categories: Electrical Equipment, Electrical Fixtures, Lighting Fixtures, Mechanical Equipment, Plumbing Fixtures, Plumbing Equipment, Specialty Equipment, Fire Alarm Devices, Data Devices, Security Devices
proposed.description: Electrical service: Power, Lighting, Emergency Lighting, Fire, Data, Security, Mechanical
proposed.why: Electrical 0.1 groups loads and circuits by service

proposed.name: FMC_Phases
proposed.categories: Electrical Equipment, Electrical Fixtures, Lighting Fixtures, Mechanical Equipment, Plumbing Fixtures, Plumbing Equipment, Specialty Equipment, Fire Alarm Devices, Data Devices, Security Devices
proposed.description: Supply phases for the load: 1 or 3

proposed.name: FMC_Design_Current_A
proposed.categories: Electrical Equipment, Electrical Fixtures, Lighting Fixtures, Mechanical Equipment, Plumbing Fixtures, Plumbing Equipment, Specialty Equipment, Fire Alarm Devices, Data Devices, Security Devices
proposed.description: Design current Ib (A), written by the calculation; the engineer checks it
proposed.why: Feeder sizing and CA-E-01 / CA-E-02 inputs

proposed.name: FMC_Protective_Device_A
proposed.description: Rated current In (A) of the protective device feeding this equipment

proposed.name: FMC_Conductor_Size_mm2
proposed.description: Sized line conductor, e.g. 4C 16 mm2 Cu XLPE/SWA; written by the calculation, the engineer approves
proposed.why: Feeder sizing result; SLD and cable schedule

proposed.name: FMC_CPC_Size_mm2
proposed.description: Circuit protective conductor size, e.g. 16 mm2 (or armour as CPC)

proposed.name: FMC_Voltage_Drop_Pct
proposed.description: Calculated voltage drop (%) to this equipment, written back from CA-E-02 or the calculation (limits 3% lighting, 5% other per BS 7671 App. 4)
proposed.why: Lets CA-E-02 write back like CA-E-03 does for lux

proposed.name: FMC_Calc_Status
proposed.categories: Electrical Equipment, Electrical Fixtures, Lighting Fixtures, Mechanical Equipment, Plumbing Fixtures, Plumbing Equipment, Specialty Equipment, Fire Alarm Devices, Data Devices, Security Devices
proposed.description: Result of the last calculation on this element: OK, WARN or FAIL (never 'approved': that is the engineer's)
proposed.why: Shows what needs an engineer's eye

proposed.name: FMC_Data_Source
proposed.categories: Electrical Equipment, Electrical Fixtures, Lighting Fixtures, Mechanical Equipment, Plumbing Fixtures, Plumbing Equipment, Specialty Equipment, Fire Alarm Devices, Data Devices, Security Devices
proposed.description: Where this element's electrical data came from: Model, Library:<id> (assumed), or Manual (a person)
proposed.why: Library guesses must stay visible as assumed

proposed.name: FMC_Elec_Code_Pack
proposed.description: Electrical code pack for calculations: iec (BS 7671 / IEC 60364) or nec; the kit default is iec
proposed.why: One code for the whole project

electrical_0_1_mapping.note: No kit parameter: FMC_Pipe_System is plumbing only; Revit's Load Classification is a load class, not the service

Same meaning. Kit binding is Electrical Fixtures and Lighting Fixtures only: widen it to the load categories (Electrical Equipment, Mechanical Equipment, Plumbing Fixtures, Specialty Equipment, Fire Alarm Devices, Data Devices)

Kit families carry rated power in FMC_Power_W (type) and set the connector's Apparent Load = FMC_Power_W / Power Factor (kit fmc_family_specs). Electrical 0.1 should read the connector's Apparent Load, not keep a second VA value

electrical_0_1_mapping.kit_parameter: built-in Voltage (family parameter linked to the connector)
electrical_0_1_mapping.note: Every kit electrical recipe adds Voltage and links it to the connector (STD-002 5.2). For a non-kit family with no connector data Electrical 0.1 should flag it, not write a guess
No kit or built-in parameter on a load says 1 or 3 phase (poles alone don't for 2-pole loads)

electrical_0_1_mapping.kit_parameter: built-in Number of Poles (family parameter linked to the connector)
electrical_0_1_mapping.note: Every kit electrical recipe adds Number of Poles and links it to the connector

The kit sets demand factors per load classification and per project, approved by the electrical engineer (Electrical_Settings; TPL-025). A per-element demand factor is not proposed: Electrical 0.1 should stop writing one
Kit load classifications: Lighting, Power, Water Heater, Motor, HVAC, Emergency Lighting, Site Lighting, Other (Electrical_Settings)
No kit parameter. BS 7671 term: design current Ib
No kit parameter. BS 7671 term: rated current In of the protective device. Revit circuits have a built-in Rating, but feeders to equipment need it on the equipment
FMC_Cable_Spec is a type parameter on conduits, trays and equipment (the cable product); the sized conductor is per feeder (instance)
No kit parameter. BS 7671 term: circuit protective conductor (CPC)
No kit parameter; CA-E-02 (Calc_E_VoltDrop) has nowhere to write back today
FMC_QA_Status is the model-check status (Unchecked/Checked...), not a calculation result
No kit parameter. Values: Model, Library:<id> (assumed), Manual; matches the kit's source_status idea
Project-wide, so bound to Project Information (one value), not to every element

notes_for_electrical_0_1: Electrical 0.1 writes its own shared-parameter file (FormCraft_SharedParameters.txt, group FormCraft) with Revit-made random GUIDs. Once the kit publishes these, it must bind the kit's file and GUIDs instead, or the same name will exist twice with different GUIDs.

Its Library/load-defaults.json is North American (120 V receptacles at 180 VA, 277 V high-bay, 240 V 2-pole water heater). Uganda projects need a 240/415 V, BS 1363 library before any default is used, and every library value stays 'assumed'.
Its IEC code pack defaults to 230 V; the kit's distribution systems are 415/240 V (Electrical_Settings).
